app.name: Yangfeng Enterprise
paragraph1:
Yangfeng Enterprise was founded in 1987. As a traditional family‑run factory, we started with a small press in the founder’s home and have since expanded to our current 100‑ping facility, equipped with multiple professional molding machines.

All molds are designed and developed in‑house by our experts, eliminating the need for outsourcing. We adhere to a customer‑first philosophy, dedicated to reducing costs and creating greater business opportunities for our clients.

We focus on craftsmanship and quality, leveraging the skills of craftsmen with over 30 years of experience and our in‑house equipment to deliver high production efficiency and superior product quality. Over the years, we have established long‑term, stable partnerships with many well‑known companies both domestically and internationally, exporting to markets across Asia, Europe, and the Americas.

As a company committed to excellence, our team is dynamic and creative, always ready to embrace every challenge and provide tailored solutions for our customers.

Looking ahead, we will continue to expand into international markets, uphold higher standards, and deliver exceptional service, striving to become a leader in our industry. Thank you for your support and trust in Yangfeng Enterprise.
